name: vision_lightning_cls
title: A Lightning image classifier with a DataModule, torchmetrics and a one-cycle schedule declared interval: step
origin: domain-vision round 1: the canonical LightningModule + LightningDataModule pair, written so that every absence rule is correctly suppressed by the framework gate

forbidden.why: training_step returns the loss and never calls backward() or step(); Lightning owns the update
configure_optimizers returns {'scheduler': scheduler, 'interval': 'step'}, which is the documented correct shape for OneCycleLR
ImageClassifier.__init__ and ImageDataModule.__init__ both call super().__init__() on their first line
the loaders are built inside the DataModule hooks, which Trainer.fit calls from main() under the __main__ guard
eval_transform() is Resize + CenterCrop + ToTensor + Normalize and is what val_ds and test_ds are built with
Lightning owns zero_grad; the framework gate exists for exactly this
Lightning puts the module in eval mode around validation_step
the ResNet-34 head returns logits and the criterion is CrossEntropyLoss
pl.seed_everything(SEED, workers=True) is the first statement of main()
the three splits are three directories; nothing is split at run time
the model is a single torchvision backbone, not a list of submodules
checkpointing is ModelCheckpoint, which writes Lightning's own state dict
